attrs.evidence: docs/spec/proof-wire/experiment/run_state.mjs shapeProblems() + uniqueProblems() + environmentDiffers(), with RESULT_MEMBERS, RESULT_SUBJECT_MEMBERS, RESULT_OBSERVATION_MEMBERS, PREDICATE_MEMBERS, INTEROP_MEMBERS, RECEIPT_MEMBERS, RECEIPT_ADAPTER_MEMBERS and ENVIRONMENT_MEMBERS as the closed vocabularies; resultProblems() refuses an ambiguous RESULT before indexing it, and chainProblems() applies the same rule to every reachable receipt and requires a carried subject's role, package digest, binary digest AND environment to be unchanged. Falsifiers Z1 (duplicate subject, bogus row first), Z2 (duplicate observation row), Z3 (subject role), Z4 (a world_root seat put back), Z5 (duplicate receipt adapter), Z6 (carried subject changes role or environment), Z8 (undeclared member), and Z7 the positive dual: an honest completion's collections are unique, prose and world_root are absent from the shape, and it still verifies. attrs.statement: AN AUTHENTICATED EVIDENCE ARTIFACT MUST HAVE EXACTLY ONE INTERPRETATION. P4.1 removed the duplicate-JSON-member hazard from the wire -- JSON.parse keeps the LAST duplicate, so bytes naming an evil protocol were authenticated as the honest artifact, and the repair was a canonical equality that makes duplicate rejection a CONSEQUENCE rather than a check. The evidence artifacts this plane invented afterwards reintroduced the same species in ARRAYS KEYED BY IDENTITY: `new Map(res.subjects.map(x => [x.implementation, x]))` collapses duplicates with the last one winning and nothing checked first. REPRODUCED against P4.7.5 on an honest, fully conforming completed run: insert a bogus `javascript` row BEFORE the genuine one in RESULT.subjects -- role candidate, 999/999 predicates, zeroed digests -- and BLIND-RUN still says PASS, because the verifier reads the last row while a reader resolving duplicates by first occurrence reads the other. The same in RESULT.observations, and the same in a reachable transition receipt's adapters. THE ARTIFACT PROVES THE RIGHT MEASUREMENT WHILE PRESENTING TWO CONTRADICTORY DESCRIPTIONS OF IT TO TWO REASONABLE READERS. AND THREE MEMBERS WERE NEVER READ AT ALL: a RESULT subject's `role` could go reference to candidate, a receipt adapter's `role` and `environment` could change halfway through the history, and `world_root` could say anything. Every collection keyed by an identity is now checked for uniqueness and label shape BEFORE it is indexed, and an ambiguous artifact is refused without any further check being attempted, because there is no single thing to check. Every shape is CLOSED and every member is DERIVED, CHECKED or NON_AUTHORITATIVE -- `law:proof.semantic-vocabulary-closed@1` one plane over. `world_root` and the prose `note` were REMOVED from the RESULT rather than checked: the first was an absolute path on the producing machine, so requiring agreement would make the artifact fail on every other machine, which is the environment-coupled-oracle defect P4.4 found and repaired in the test plane rather than in the identity; the second was the unhashed-notes seat P3.1 retired one plane down.
